author: Paul
authorNote: The letter names Paul as author. Many scholars question whether Paul wrote it himself (it may come from a follower writing in his name), while others defend Pauline authorship.
overview: Ephesians celebrates everything God has done in Christ: choosing, forgiving and bringing Jews and Gentiles together into one body. "By grace you have been saved through faith." The second half shows how to live it out, at church, at home and in spiritual battle.
